monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral magnifier and task-light decision system covering exact reading tasks, optical and digital tool types, working distance, field of view, glare, package stability, privacy, power, a three-system comparison, complete first-year burden, and a realistic return-window test. It adds no merchant, model, price, coupon, ranking, stock claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement and preserves existing-tool and no-purchase outcomes.

image_qa.note: The label-evidence guide, magnifier and task-light guide, and search-date trust control use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No cannabis product, cultivar, plant, magnifier, light, merchant, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The September 28–October 25 report showed 841 impressions, four clicks, 0.476% CTR, and average position 22.477. It is seven days old and usable, but no unaddressed editorial query or page had meaningful volume in the roughly position-4-to-20 band, so no item is primarily Data-led. The Guides hub and Stem Cell CBG had already been reinforced; About, Contact, Affiliate Disclosure, and Editorial Policy are navigational; Montana has two impressions; the HTTP, pre-roll, and federal-property rows have one impression; and Blue Dream sits mostly around positions 40–61. The report prevented another overlapping CBG, hub, Montana, pre-roll, federal-property, or Blue Dream page. The existing sitemap warnings remained a discovery concern, so the release preserves the canonical live-response gate while adding search-result date parity rather than another isolated page.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy label-evidence guide anchored by the peer-reviewed systematic review published October 24, 2026 and two major composition/genetics studies. Its meaning map, evidence matrix, exact-product record, six-gate shopping comparison, expectation record, and language crosswalk strengthen the terpene, flower, product-label, and strain-field-note cluster through reciprocal contextual links. No speculative outreach target was added and no outreach was sent.
